title: The Silent Voice in the Chamber
intro: A prayer echoed in the stillness of a sacred chamber long ago, rising from an aging soul yearning for what the world had declared impossible. This figure, advanced in years and burdened with worry for the future, turned to their Lord with a personal supplication. What followed was a divine response that defied every natural expectation—a testament to the mercy of the One who answers the desperate call.
clues: I called upon my Lord in private, withdrawing to a chamber where I devoted myself to His worship.
I admitted to my Lord that I feared for those who would come after me, worried for the guidance of my people once I departed.
Old age had overtaken me—my bones had grown weak and white hair had spread across my head.
My spouse had been barren her entire life, yet I still asked my Lord to grant me an heir from His own presence.
I requested a sign, and my Lord answered by preventing me from speaking to anyone for three nights, while I remained physically sound.
I was promised a son whose name would be Yahya, a name my Lord declared had never been given to any before.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
